comment: Every Rust listing in the ch15-40 manuscript must be real code from that chapter's crate. book-sync covers ch1-14 only; nothing covered Part II+, which is how the book came to print Clock::new(...) in five places after D112 removed the software clock. The repository README is swept with them (id chRM/N) because it walks tinyalu_tb the way the Interlude does and rots the same way. Code-only comparison (the book strips the crates' teaching comments by design). Exemptions live in KNOWN_DRIFT inside the script, each with a reason and an owner, and that register must only shrink. No simulator needed.
